🎥🎬: Sirens (2014–2015)

Working as paramedics in Chicago, Johnny, Hank and Brian are three emergency medical technicians whose demanding jobs expose them to some of the strangest, funniest and most unpredictable situations imaginable. While they spend their days responding to emergencies and saving lives, their personal lives are filled with complicated relationships, awkward encounters and questionable decisions.

Johnny is a dedicated but emotionally complicated paramedic, Hank is his experienced and unconventional partner, while Brian is the enthusiastic rookie still trying to figure out how to handle the pressures of the job. Together, they navigate bizarre emergencies, difficult patients and the everyday chaos of working in emergency services.

Between outrageous calls, workplace rivalries and romantic complications, the three friends discover that surviving life outside the ambulance can sometimes be harder than handling the emergencies inside it.
